description_en: Queries the Location Blacklist configuration for an Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance
description_zh: 查询针对DDoS高防实例的区域封禁配置
name: DescribeNetworkRegionBlock

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID信息
parameters.name: instance_id

Config.description_en: The configuration of the location blacklist

Countries.description_en: The list of blocked region codes outside China
Countries.description_zh: 被封禁的海外地域代码列表

items.description_en:
The blocked region code outside China.

For more information about region codes outside China, see [Parameters of the China and global region types]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html）
items.description_zh:
被封禁的海外地域代码。

关于海外地域代码的详细信息，请参见[地域类型参数取值说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html）

Provinces.description_en: The list of blocked region codes in China
Provinces.description_zh: 被封禁的中国地域代码列表

items.description_en:
The blocked region code in China. For example, 11 indicates Beijing and 12 indicates Tianjin.

For more information about region codes in China, see [Parameters of the China and global region types]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html）
items.description_zh:
被封禁的中国地域代码。例如，11表示北京市、12表示天津市。

关于中国地域代码的详细信息，请参见[地域类型参数取值说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167926.html）

RegionBlockSwitch.description_en:
The status of the location blacklist. Valid values:
on: enabled
off: disabled
RegionBlockSwitch.description_zh:
区域封禁的开关状态。取值：
on：开启
off：关闭
